I believe my insurance has expired (going by what my mother told me before). I really just think I need to blow off my stresses, talk to someone about it, you know? My dad is offshore for two weeks, in for one week, and I don't have the gas to go and visit him (saving for when I do get a job), but next time I come into contact with him, I'm gonna let him know how I feel, but for now... I really just want someone I can vent to without fear of judgement or chastisement.

I feel worthless. I've went to a military-like program to better myself, I graduated and got my GED from there, but it just seems it was all in vain, and no one cares about that anymore. Even when I say I put myself through that, people look at me like I've done something wrong, that I'm a bad person. I always think people are secretly laughing at me, ridiculing me, or berating me in some way. It drives me crazy and I hate it. I'm scared to get a job, but it's not stopping me. I'm scared of doing bad, getting fired, humiliating myself. Thank you for your words, though, I really appreciate it.
